name: Draw Box
description: Draws a colored box (outline or filled) on the picture.

params.name: x
params.description: Left edge of the box, in pixels

params.name: y
params.description: Top edge of the box, in pixels

params.name: width
params.description: Width of the box in pixels; 0 = the width of the picture

params.name: height
params.description: Height of the box in pixels; 0 = the height of the picture

params.name: color
params.description: Color of the box; alpha is its opacity

params.name: thickness
params.description: Thickness of the outline in pixels

params.name: replace
params.description: Replace the color and alpha of the pixels instead of blending

params.name: invert
params.description: Invert the color of the pixels of the box instead of drawing `color` (FFmpeg: color `invert`)
